lines: Sunday 9:30pm Perth: Eagles at Jaguars in London, JAX -7.5, total 41.5. Jacksonville is 3-1 after beating Cincinnati.
Monday 1:00am: Browns at Jets, NYJ -2.5, total 39.5 in the rain. Cleveland is 3-1 and on a W3 run.
Monday 1:00am: Colts at Steelers, PIT -3, total 43.5. Pittsburgh is 2-2 off the 27-24 loss in Cleveland.
Monday 4:25am: 49ers at Seahawks, SEA -3, total 45.5. San Francisco is 4-0 after beating Denver 24-14.
Monday 8:20am: Ravens at Falcons, ATL -3.5, total 43.5. Atlanta hung 45 on New Orleans.
Tuesday 8:15am: Bills at Rams on ESPN and ABC, LAR -3, total 54.5. Buffalo lost 29-26 at home to New England.

pregame.matchup_read: Bengals at 2-2 go to Miami as CIN -6.5 against an 0-4 Dolphins side, total 43.5. Cincinnati moved the ball in Week 4 with 437 yards but ran for 23 on 15 carries. Hard Rock, 33C, intermittent clouds.
storylines: ESPN headline: Bengals look to end a two-game skid with Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins status unclear, both dealing with injuries.
Higgins went for 11 rec, 157 yds against Jacksonville. Burrow threw 54 times for 428 yards with 1 TD and 2 INT in that 22-17 loss.
Miami lost 15-10 at Minnesota and sits 0-4. Headline: Dolphins HC Jeff Hafley challenged LB Chop Robinson after a dominant Week 4 showing.
Cincinnati is last in the AFC North on streak, L2, behind CLE 3-1, BAL 3-1 and PIT 2-2, despite the best point diff at +12.
watch_for: Who lines up wide. If Chase and Higgins are limited, Dohnte Meyers (7 rec, 82 yds last week) and Chase Brown out of the backfield carry volume.
The run game. Nine Chase Brown carries went for 10 yards against Jacksonville, 1.5 yards per attempt as a team.
Penalties. Cincinnati had 11 for 108 yards in Week 4 and went 2-4 in the red zone.
pregame.the_call: Bengals win but do not cover the 6.5. A banged-up receiver room plus a 1.5 yards per carry run game says this is a grind, closer to 23-20 than a rout.

postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati moved the ball and still lost. 437 yards, 26 first downs, but 23 rushing yards on 15 carries, 2-of-4 in the red zone, two Burrow picks and 11 penalties for 108 yards. Jacksonville turned it over zero times.
standouts: Tee Higgins: 11 catches, 157 yards. Carried the passing game with no touchdown to show for it.
Joe Burrow: 39/54, 428 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT, plus a 6-yard rushing score on three carries.
Trevor Lawrence: 18/23, 227 yards, 1 TD, no picks. Clean game, and ESPN notes it is his first win over the Bengals.
postgame.division_meaning: Cincinnati sits last in the AFC North at 2-2 on an L2, behind Cleveland (3-1, W3) and Baltimore (3-1, W2) and level with Pittsburgh (2-2, L1). Point differential is still a plus-12.
postgame.the_take: A 428-yard passing day that produces 17 points is a run game problem, not a Burrow problem. Until 1.5 yards a carry changes, every red zone trip is a coin flip. ESPN also flags a receiver health question.
